All the control surfaces on a DC-3 are metal with a fabric covering. We recovered all control surfaces last winter. Except for rudder what was still on the airplane, we are doing it now at our shop in Deland Florida.
How many people does it take to install a new aileron on Mr. Douglas! lol.
Let's hang the right aileron , while Sox prepares the right engine to be removed. That right engines been on there inoperative for 18 years.

Let's get this right engine off, it has not run in 18 years.

We are very humbled and overwhelmed with pride as we installed the Left Elevator this afternoon on Mr. Douglas. It's so important that we preserve our history for future generations to learn about, and enjoy. .

We are offering at auction this historic original Mister Douglas t-shirt from 1976. Thanks Larry for preserving it all these years, and donating it to The Mr. Douglas Society Inc. We are hoping to raise $50,000 By selling these legacy plaques on the jump seats of Mr. Douglas. Your name will forever be apart of the Mr. Douglas flying museum. The Mr. Douglas Society is a 501(c)(3) public charity. All donations are 100% tax deductible. We are also able to receive property. Or items of value that can be sold to benefit the charity. So please include us as on your list of charitable giving. Let’s keep Mr. Douglas flying long after we’re gone.
